limitations_and_boundaries: Current pretraining does not inherently mitigate batch effects, constraining zero-shot performance on datasets with substantial technical variation.
Evaluation is complex due to frequent absence of definitive biological ground truths and variation in data quality.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

missed_core_items.description: scaling effect: larger pretraining data sizes yield improved performance on downstream tasks
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: We observed that the performance of fine-tuned models improved as the amount of pretraining data increased (Supplementary Note 4). These results indicate a scaling effect, suggesting that greater pretraining data size leads to better pretrained embeddings and improved performance on downstream tasks.

missed_core_items.description: in-context pretraining effect: organ-specific models pretrained on relevant cell types perform better on downstream tasks
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Our analysis revealed a clear correlation between the relevance of the model's context in pretraining and its subsequent performance for integrating data (Supplementary Fig. 8).

missed_core_items.description: scGPT outperforms models trained from scratch (scGPT from scratch) in downstream tasks
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: The results are presented in Supplementary Tables 2–4, where the fine-tuned scGPT consistently showcases performance gain for tasks such as integration and cell type annotation.

missed_core_items.description: scGPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on batch correction and multi-omic integration tasks
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: scGPT consistently achieves competitive scores across all integration metrics and demonstrates strong conservation of biological signals (Supplementary Table 3 and Supplementary Figs. 6 and 7).

missed_core_items.description: scGPT demonstrates superior performance in multi-omic integration on BMMC dataset with 9% improvement in AvgBIO score over Seurat
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: scGPT presented more defined cluster structures than Seurat (v.4), with a 9% improvement in the AvgBIO score.

missed_core_items.description: scGPT demonstrates superior performance in mosaic data integration on ASAP PBMC dataset
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: scGPT demonstrated superior batch correction performance as shown in Fig. 4d, especially in groups of B, myeloid and natural killer (NK) cells.

missed_core_items.description: scGPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on perturbation prediction, outperforming GEARS and linear regression by 5-20% margins
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: Our results demonstrate that scGPT achieved the highest scores for all three datasets (Fig. 3a and Supplementary Table 6). Particularly, scGPT excelled in predicting post-perturbation changes, consistently outperforming the others by 5–20% margins.

missed_core_items.description: scGPT achieves 91.4% relevant and 65.7% correct reverse perturbation predictions within top 8, outperforming GEARS and differential gene baseline
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: scGPT identified on average 91.4% relevant perturbations (6.4 of seven) within the top 1 predictions (blue bars in Fig. 3g) and 65.7% correct perturbations (4.6 of seven test cases) within the top 8 predictions (pink bars in Fig. 3g), outperforming GEARS and the differential gene baseline by a considerable margin.

missed_core_items.description: scGPT demonstrates ability to group functionally related genes and differentiate functionally distinct genes via learned gene token embeddings (HLA and CD gene networks)
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: scGPT demonstrates its ability to group functionally related genes and differentiate functionally distinct genes via learned gene token embeddings.

missed_core_items.description: scGPT uncovers meaningful gene programs with cell type-specific activation, validated by pathway enrichment analysis showing higher number of enriched pathways compared to coexpression network
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: scGPT consistently demonstrates a substantially higher number of enriched pathways across all clustering resolutions.

missed_core_items.description: scGPT attention mechanism captures cell state-specific gene-gene interactions validated by ChIP-Atlas for DDIT3 and BHLHE40 perturbations
missed_core_items.source_excerpt: In the Adamson CRISPR interference dataset33, scGPT identified the top 20 genes most influenced by repression of DDIT3 (encoding a transcription factor), which were all found to be signaling targets of DDIT3 in the ChIP-Atlas database51 (Fig. 6b).

methods.name: Fine-tuning for perturbation prediction
methods.protocol_description: Model fine-tuned on a subset of perturbations to predict perturbed expression profile given control cell state and perturbed genes; tested on unseen perturbations.
